info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Market Operation By Param1-spec
info.description: The Unit Trust Administration Market Operations API provides access to market data specific to unit trust operations using the designated parameter. This endpoint enables users to retrieve essential market operation details based on a specific identifier, streamlining the process of accessing targeted financial information. It is designed for financial institutions, investment brokers, and analysts who require precise market insights to inform their decision-making. Users can efficiently utilize this API to enhance their services and improve operational workflows related to unit trusts.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific unit trust administration record identified by its unique identifier. You can use this to review the administration specifics for operational insight and decision-making.
